audit.whatIsWrong: Prose claimed you 'out-range the lane from level 1' and called Lux 'him' in a dozen fields.
audit.why: Lux is female per champ-gender.js, and she out-ranges Hwei: Light Binding 1175, Prismatic Barrier 1150, Lucent Singularity 1100, Final Spark 3340. The lane is won by minion-blocking the root, not by range.
audit.corrected: Even at 5.5/10, 53.4% over 3,470 games. Difficulty is positional: keep a minion on the line and her combo has no opener.

audit.whatIsWrong: All seven full-layer phases[N].side read 'Skill' while content win[] read Hwei/Hwei/Hwei/Skill/Skill/Hwei/Hwei and matched the packet levelChart.
audit.why: Levels 1-3 Hwei's two-spell detonation beats anything she lands off a flat-10-second root. Levels 4-6 are the mutual skillshot check, and Final Spark at 3340 makes 6 genuinely even. First item onward your burst beats a 12-second single-target shield.
audit.corrected: phases[0..2].side to Hwei, phases[3..4] stay Skill, phases[5..6].side to Hwei, with each why rewritten to the row's verdict.

audit.whatIsWrong: Lux's abilities were assigned to the wrong slots throughout the content layer — 'her E shield' (Prismatic Barrier is W) and 'her E snare' (Light Binding is Q) — plus a fabricated Hwei ability 'Severance', a 'Devastating Fire fear' (Devastating Fire is the QQ damage paint; the fear is Grim Visage) and a Hwei 'W wall' that does not exist.
audit.why: Riot's data: Q Light Binding (1175, flat 10s, binds up to two units), W Prismatic Barrier (1150 shield), E Lucent Singularity (1100 slow zone), R Final Spark (3340). Hwei's W line is Fleeting Current, Pool of Reflection and Stirring Lights — no wall.
audit.corrected: Every slot corrected; the minion-block on Light Binding stated as the decisive interaction, and the Illumination auto-reset noted as the burst tell.

audit.why: Light Binding is a flat 10s at every rank, Lucent Singularity 10 down to 8, Prismatic Barrier 12 down to 10, Final Spark 60/50/40.
audit.corrected: Numbers written in; the flat 10s is the concrete commit window since it never shortens.

edits.before: You outrange most of Lux's short trades once you set up E first — landing Devastating Fire's fear lets you follow with Q for more combined damage than her Q-E can answer with. Her Q has a slow projectile and telegraphed animation, so whiffed Qs are your cue to shove and threaten a roam. Watch for level 3 onward when she starts chaining Q into E for full poke combos on cooldown; if you're patient with your own E angles instead of throwing them blind, you win most exchanges through levels 1-3.
edits.after: You out-trade most of Lux's poke once you set up E first — landing Grim Visage's fear lets you follow with QQ for more combined damage than Light Binding into Lucent Singularity answers with. Her Q is a slow projectile that stops on the first two units, so a whiffed root is a flat 10 seconds and your cue to shove and threaten a roam. Watch for level 3 onward when she starts chaining Q into E on cooldown; if you're patient with your own E angles instead of throwing them blind, you win most exchanges through levels 1-3.

edits.before: Level 6 is the one phase to respect fully - Lux's Final Spark can one-shot a squishy from off-screen if you're caught pushed up alone, so play around wards and her ult cooldown even though your raw combo damage is higher. Through levels 4-5 the fight is a mutual skillshot check: her E snare is a bigger commitment for her than your E fear is for you, so trades stay close and come down to who lands first. Use R to zone the wave and force her off it rather than all-inning through her shield.
edits.after: Level 6 is the one phase to respect fully - Final Spark reaches 3340 and is 60 seconds at rank 1, so play around wards and that timer even though your raw combo damage is higher. Through levels 4-5 the fight is a mutual skillshot check: her Light Binding is a bigger commitment for her than Grim Visage is for you, so trades stay close and come down to who lands first. Use R to zone the wave and force her off it rather than all-inning through Prismatic Barrier.

edits.before: Once you have Liandry's or Shadowflame online, your full combo burns through her E shield before she can peel with it, letting you burst her down in skirmishes and teamfights. She still threatens a one-shot Final Spark from safety, so avoid facechecking bushes and use W wall to deny her sightlines - without an angle, she can't open the fight safely.

notes: Lux's slots were wrong across the whole content layer: 'her E shield' is Prismatic Barrier (W) and 'her E snare' is Light Binding (Q). Also removed the fabricated Hwei ability 'Severance', the mislabelled 'Devastating Fire fear' (Devastating Fire is the QQ damage paint; the fear is Grim Visage, EQ) and a Hwei 'W wall' that does not exist — his W line is Fleeting Current, Pool of Reflection and Stirring Lights. Chart: content win[] already matched the packet levelChart; only the full-layer sides were stale at 'Skill', so five rows moved with no paired win[N] edit because the content layer already holds the target value. The Illumination auto-reset tell from missingInteractions is not written into a field this pass — every candidate field was already at its length limit with higher-value content, and I would not cut a real cooldown to fit it.
